Summary: Large regional health system focused on PHI-sensitive inference. Primary ask = Private VPC with an on-prem, air-gapped option for High-risk clinical workloads. Key constraints: absolutely no outbound telemetry containing PHI; must support customer-managed KMS/HSM (Thales/CloudHSM acceptable), FIPS 140-2 validated crypto, and detailed audit logging with tamper-evidence. POC asks: 1) air-gapped deployable container images and signed checksums; 2) offline model weight ingestion process + reproducible seed for deterministic evals; 3) integration guides for customer KMS + rotation schedule; 4) proofs for zero-egress and local-only telemetry; 5) performance profile for A30/A100 with batch sizes for sub-200ms 95th percentile on clinical note summarization. Quotes: "We cannot transmit ANY PHI off-prem — that is non-negotiable" (CTO), "Need SOC2+ISO ring for vendor before legal will sign" (Head of InfoSec).

Recent call notes (fragments):
- Security requested SC-8 encryption proof and HSM keywrap examples.
- Ops asked about air-gap image delivery: 'signed tarball over encrypted thumbdrive' vs 'sftp in DMZ' options.
- Compliance: data residency annex must state logs retained 7 years, and ability to export audit trail in tamper-evident format.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to accept higher ARR for fully air-gapped on-prem option but expects clear tradeoffs on SLA and support windows.

POC scope suggested by SE (Maya): 6-week POC, deliverables = air-gapped deployment runbook, KMS integration test, sample audit logs, perf report on two workloads (summarization + embeddings). POC blockers: procurement SLA, on-prem hardware delivery, SOC2 evidence (they require Redwood to provide SOC2 + at least one ISO cert).
